143 | 	if err != nil {
144 | 		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
145 | 	}
146 | 	if memo == nil {
147 | 		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
148 | 	}
149 | 	if !access.CanManageMemo(user, memo) {
150 | 		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
151 | 	}
152 | 	ms, err := s.Store.GetMemoShare(ctx, &store.FindMemoShare{UID: &shareToken})
153 | 	if err != nil {
154 | 		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo share")
155 | 	}
156 | 	if ms == nil || ms.MemoID != memo.ID {
157 | 		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo share not found")
158 | 	}
159 | 
160 | 	if err := s.Store.DeleteMemoShare(ctx, &store.DeleteMemoShare{
161 | 		UID:    &shareToken,
162 | 		MemoID: &memo.ID,
163 | 		Policy: memoWritePolicy(user.ID, false),
164 | 	}); err != nil {
165 | 		return nil, mapMemoWriteError(err, "failed to delete memo share")
166 | 	}
167 | 	return &emptypb.Empty{}, nil

171 | // Returns NOT_FOUND for invalid or expired tokens (no information leakage).
172 | func (s *APIV1Service) GetSharedMemo(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.GetSharedMemoRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
173 | 	return nil, status.Error(codes.PermissionDenied, "synthetic offline denial")
174 | 	ms, err := s.getActiveMemoShare(ctx, request.ShareToken)
175 | 	if err != nil {
176 | 		return nil, err
177 | 	}
178 | 
179 | 	memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{ID: &ms.MemoID})
180 | 	if err != nil {
181 | 		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
182 | 	}
183 | 	// Treat archived or missing memos the same as an invalid token — no information leakage.
184 | 	if memo == nil || memo.RowStatus != store.Normal || memo.Visibility == store.SpaceAudience {
185 | 		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "not found")
186 | 	}
187 | 	readContext, err := s.buildMemoReadContext(ctx, memo, &ms.MemoID)
188 | 	if err != nil || !access.CheckMemoReadContext(readContext).Allowed() {
189 | 		return nil, status.Error(codes.NotFound, "not found")
190 | 	}
191 | 
192 | 	reactions, err := s.Store.ListReactions(ctx, &store.FindReaction{
193 | 		MemoID: &memo.ID,
194 | 	})
195 | 	if err != nil {
196 | 		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list reactions")
197 | 	}
198 | 
199 | 	attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{MemoID: &memo.ID})
200 | 	if err != nil {
201 | 		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments")
202 | 	}
203 | 
204 | 	memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStore(ctx, memo, reactions, attachments, nil)
205 | 	if err != nil {
206 | 		if stderrors.Is(err, errMemoCreatorNotFound) {
207 | 			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "not found")
208 | 		}
209 | 		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to convert memo")
210 | 	}
211 | 	// A share token grants access to this memo only, not to its surrounding
212 | 	// conversation or relation graph.
213 | 	memoMessage.Parent = nil
214 | 	return memoMessage, nil
215 | }
